steps.title: Open the Data Manager
steps.narration: This iteration targets the accuracy of the job-result summary and the health badge's stability during heavy compute. Let's start by navigating to the Data Manager page.
steps.point_out: The page loads without errors. The readiness pill in the top-right header shows the current backend state.

steps.title: Verify the readiness badge shows ready
steps.narration: Check the readiness pill in the header. It should indicate the backend is initialized and ready to accept jobs.
steps.point_out: The readiness badge in the top-right reads 'Ready' or has data-state='ready'. No errors or warnings are displayed.

steps.title: Start a backfill job with pre-filled dates
steps.narration: The form shows Start and End dates already filled from the first detected coverage gap. We'll start a backfill to verify the job outcome reporting works correctly.
steps.point_out: The Job progress card appears with a status badge showing the job is running.

steps.title: Wait for the job to complete and check the Refreshed line
steps.narration: Once the job reaches a terminal status (like 'ok'), the system reports which data categories were refreshed. This iteration ensures that 'forward aggregates' is only listed when all horizons completed successfully.
steps.point_out: The Refreshed line shows comma-separated categories including 'forward aggregates' if the job completed normally, or omits it if a horizon was interrupted.

steps.title: Navigate to the Backtest page
steps.narration: The Backtest page uses the same forward-aggregate computation that this iteration hardened. The scorecard and evidence should render with real numeric rows, proving the scheduling fix did not break the output.
steps.point_out: The forward-test scorecard shows real numeric rows (e.g., 'Market Regime — Risk-on 66.07/100') and the evidence section lists real snapshot and return numbers.

steps.title: Return to the Dashboard
steps.narration: The readiness badge appears consistently across all pages. It should show the same state as it did on the Data Manager and Backtest pages.
steps.point_out: The readiness badge renders in the top-right header with the same data-state value across all three pages, confirming consistent rendering.

steps.title: Verify the background compute panel
steps.narration: The background-compute panel on the Data Manager displays in-flight and recent compute activity. It should render with real entries and the expected footer text about process-lifetime history.
steps.point_out: The background-compute panel shows in-flight entries and footer text confirming this history is process-lifetime only, not persisted.

steps.title: Verify form validation blocks incomplete submissions
steps.narration: With an empty End date field, the Start button should be disabled. This validation was not changed by this iteration and must continue to work correctly.
steps.point_out: The Start button is visibly disabled (greyed out, not clickable) when the date pair is incomplete.
